## What's Changed
* Remove irrelevant comment from CL_4023106 by @matentzn in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3643
* Migrate NTR editing pipeline from GitHub Copilot to Claude (dragon-ai-agent) by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3661
* Add CL term for hippocampal bistratified interneuron and clarify bistratified-cell scope note by @RiveraAndrea83 with @Copilot in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3637
* Fix misspelling: "neurectodermal" → "neuroectodermal" for CL:0000133 by @RiveraAndrea83 with @Copilot in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3604
* Add Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct by @matentzn in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3662
* Refactor AI Agent workflow for app token usage by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3689
* Add 'blister-like cell' (CL:9900001) NTR - Issue #3687 by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3696
* Fix typos in epinephrine secreting cell definition (CL:0000454) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3714
* Fix 33 spelling errors across 28 terms in cl-edit.owl (#3711) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3715
* Buccal mucosa cell edits by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3717
* Update CLARA workflow repository reference by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3718
* Add new datatype idrange:84 with annotations by @dosumis in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3719
* Fixing logical definition #3723 by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3725
* NTR pancreatic islet macrophage by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3721
* Fixing neuroendocrine cell SC #3724 by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3731
* Fix smooth muscle cell SC by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3727
* Fixing olfactory epithelial cell hidden GCI #3724 by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3734
* Taxon constraint update: added SubClass of Ecdysozoa and annotations #3666 by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3736
* Update pr_terms.txt by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3746
* Route text changes on existing terms for CLARA review by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3720
* Add new term: hippocampal trilaminar cell (CL:9900000) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3745
* Adding SubClass of epithelial cell to mucous and serous secreting cell by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3737
* Add crustin hemocyte and TGase hemocyte (fixes #3690) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3735
* Fix interplexiform cell hidden GCI by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3733
* Remove 'DC2'/'type 2 DC' synonyms from plasmacytoid dendritic cell; add 'plasmacytoid cell' + origin comment (issue #3567) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3695
* [NTR] Add iron-recycling macrophage (CL:9900001) by @RiveraAndrea83 with @Copilot in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3614
* Add 'resorptive cell' (CL:9900001) and 'fibrillar cell' (CL:9900002) NTR - Issue #3688 by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3738
* Pin CLARA_WORKFLOW_REF, add --catalog, fix cell_id->term_id by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3764
* Fix track_progress forcing the wrong claude-code-action mode by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3766
* TEMP DEBUG: enable show_full_output on claude-code-action by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3767
* Fix stage 2/3: pin --model, action was resolving to a nonexistent one by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3768
* Revert track_progress to its original conditional by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3769
* Remove temporary show_full_output debug flag by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3770
* Bump CLARA_WORKFLOW_REF to pick up the colon-in-paths fix by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3771
* ci: fix Asta MCP config so CLARA stage 3 gets snippet_search by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3772
* ci(clara): load MCP config from pinned clara_workflow ref by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3773
* fix(CL:4023068): restrict soma location to 'dorsal plus ventral thalamus' (#3791) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3793
* NTR: bone marrow adipocyte (issue #3531) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3749
* Add new term: tonsil centroblast (CL:9900000) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3708
* ci(gogoeditdiff): modernise diff workflow and fix comment visibility by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3802
* Replace obsoleted GO:0071971 with GO:1990182 in CL:0000558 (reticulocyte) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3799
* Update type S enteroendocrine cell definition by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3743
* Add sublingual gland demilune acinar cell (CL:9900000) - fixes #3529 by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3722
* Issue #3601: reclassify beam B cell as a subclass of beam cell by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3747
* Juxtaglomerular cell iss3763 by @mkeays in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3774
* NTR: add sympathoblast (CL_9900001) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3810
* gogoeditdiff: keep a single report comment per PR, always at the bottom by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3825
* Add cerebellum-like structure neuron grouping classes by @dosumis in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3828
* Add region + neurotransmitter grouping classes for brain neurons (#3788) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3797
* Import COB and BFO; strip upper-level BFO classes from releases by @matentzn in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3827
* Fix typos and PMID errors in 6 CL terms (issue #3835) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3836
* NTR perivascular renal mesenchymal progenitor cell by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3742
* NTR: mesothelial cell of visceral abdominal adipose tissue (CL:9900000) - fixes #3805 by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3806
* Add CL:9900000 Norn cell (issue #3751) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3752
* Make beam B cell a subclass of beam cell; drop human-only qualifier (#3601) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3748
* NTR: epithelial cell of mesonephric duct (CL:9900000) — fixes #3811 by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3812
* Fix incorrect plasmacytoid DC parent for CL:0002394 (cDC1) (#3784) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3829
* Add new term 'bone marrow endothelial cell' (CL:9900001) — issue #3818 by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3819
* Add new term: submucosal gut fibroblast (CL:9900001) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3815
* Broaden soma location of sst chodl GABAergic interneuron to telencephalon by @cellsemantic in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3831
* Region-free ganglionic eminence (MGE/CGE/LGE) GABAergic neuron classes (#3789) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3801
* Add region x neurotransmitter grouping classes for remaining brain regions by @cellsemantic in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3832
* Broaden CL_4030000 from choroidal melanocyte to uveal melanocyte (#3807) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3808
* 3570 multiciliated metadata by @mkeays in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3824
* medium spiny neuron: soma location corpus striatum → striatum by @cellsemantic in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3840
* Enterocyte refactor renaming by @JABelfiore in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/2944
* Raise ROBOT heap in QC workflow from 6G to 12G by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3854
* Refresh imports by @ct31-sanger in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3842
* CL_0010011: restore UBERON cerebral cortex as soma location (replace human-only DHBA term) by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3855
* QC workflow: actually apply the ROBOT heap (ROBOT_JAVA_ARGS env) by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3856
* Add BSPO to CL imports by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3859
* Implement interneuron sensu lato / local / projection split (issue #3837 A–D) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3841
* Fix definitions for 3 immune cell terms (issue #3861) by @ai4c-agent[bot] in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3864
* Strip CL axioms from PCL before building cl-plus by @cellsemantic in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3862
* Replace leftover temporary ID CL_9900000 with projection neuron CL:0020139 by @cellsemantic in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3866
* Refresh imports and components (2026-11-13) by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3868
* CL release 2026-11-13 by @ubyndr in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3869

## New Contributors
* @ai4c-agent[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3696
* @ct31-sanger made their first contribution in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3717
* @cellsemantic made their first contribution in https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/pull/3831
